d.ko: Traveloot is a run-based incremental game where you guide a growing team of adventurers across islands. Gather resources, fight enemies, unlock branching skill tree, and find new party members to join your team. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.
d.en: Traveloot is a run-based incremental game where you guide a growing team of adventurers across islands. Gather resources, fight enemies, unlock branching skill tree, and find new party members to join your team. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.
d.zh: Traveloot 是一款肉鸽增量动作冒险游戏。你将带领一支不断壮大的冒险者小队探索各大岛屿。收集资源、击退成群的敌人、解锁分支技能树，并招募新伙伴加入队伍。游戏支持单人游玩及本地合作模式。
